description: Fetch the ownership challenge from the previously registered receiver and activate it when valid. First publish the exact challenge returned by register_destination. Requires the management token; does not deliver an event. Use get_destination_status to inspect progress without activation.

hookId.description: Hook identifier returned by registration; preserve for all subsequent operations.

managementToken.description: Private management token returned by registration. Required for status, activation, revocation and credits; not the delivery token.
